name: Pupmancer
description:
About This Game

BECOME A PUPMANCER

Pupmancer is an action extraction roguelite where you play as a magic wielding pup, find a ton of spells, fight your way through dungeons, and try to make it back with everything you found.

Go in alone or bring up to 3 friends with you.

Find spells. Find loot. Get stronger. Go deeper.

Just make sure you actually make it back or you will drop everything in the dungeon.

100+ SPELLS

There are over 100 spells to find, use, upgrade, and make builds around.

Throw fireballs, summon creatures, drop huge AOEs, use movement spells to teleport or dash around enemies, protect yourself with defensive magic, or just find some completely stupid combination that somehow works.

Spells come in different rarities and can be stored in your stash for later runs.

There are a lot of them.

GO DEEPER

Every dungeon has an objective you need to complete before you can descend.

Once you finish it, you have a choice.

Extract at every 5th floor and bring everything home, or keep going.

The deeper you go, the more you are risking but the better the rewards get.

Sometimes you should probably leave.

You probably won’t.

BUILD YOUR PUP

Customize your pup with different colors, eyes, ears and tails.

Level up your Pupmancer and spend Training Points in the Training Spellbook to permanently upgrade your character.

Upgrade your spells, find better gear, collect potions, fill your stash with stuff you swear you’re going to use eventually, and keep making your pup stronger.

There isn’t one build you have to play.

Try stuff and find what works for you.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS

Pupmancer can be played completely solo or with up to 4 players online.

Bring different spells and builds into the dungeon, revive each other when things go wrong, combine abilities, and see how far your group can make it.

You can also pet your friends pups.

Obviously this is important.

THERE’S A LOT OF MAGIC

100+ spells

Solo or 4 player online co-op

Different dungeon objectives

Randomized dungeon runs

Spell upgrades and rarities

Permanent character progression

Training Spellbook skill tree

Equipment, potions, loot, and a stash

Status effects and tons of different builds

PvP

Petting da dogs

Grab your grimoire, grab some friends, and see how far you can get!
short_desc: Pupmancer is a top-down 3D action roguelite where you fight through dangerous dungeons as a magic-wielding pup. Discover powerful spells, loot, craft potions, and build your pup’s abilities to survive each run. Adventure solo or team up online with friends to take on enemies or fight in PvP battles.
